SubActionDefinitions
text:
subscription SubActionDefinitions {
      action_definition(order_by: { id: desc }) {
        archived
        created_at
        description
        id
        name
        owner
        settings
        updated_at
        updated_by
        versions(order_by: { revision: desc }) {
          action_definition_id
          action_file_id
          archived
          author
          created_at
          parameter_schema
          revision
          settings_schema
        }
        workspace_id
      }
    }

name: SubActionRun
text:
subscription SubActionRun($actionRunId: Int!) {
      actionRun: action_run_by_pk(id: $actionRunId) {
        action_definition_id
        action_definition {
          archived
          created_at
          description
          id
          name
          owner
          settings
          updated_at
          updated_by
          versions(order_by: { revision: desc }) {
            action_definition_id
            action_file_id
            archived
            author
            created_at
            parameter_schema
            revision
            settings_schema
          }
          workspace_id
        }
        action_definition_revision
        canceled
        duration
        error
        id
        logs
        parameters
        requested_at
        requested_by
        results
        settings
        status
      }
    }
